text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — AcmeHealth POC blocked by procurement on two items: (1) "usage tiering" ambiguity (seat vs compute) and (2) SLA credit calc. PDF attached. Can legal + sales_ops weigh in? @Samir Patel @Jessie Rivera

Samir Patel: Can you paste the exact order‑form rows? procurement says Section 3.2 is vague.

Maria Chen: copy/paste below:
```
Order Form - Billing
- Usage Tiering: Customer will be billed according to Tier A/B/C based on "utilization units".
- Credits: SLA credits applied as percentage of monthly invoice for downtime > SLA.
```

Jessie Rivera: procurement needs definitions: what's a 'utilization unit'? Billing wants examples (monthly estimated tokens / calls / vCPU-hrs).

Pranav Rao: From POC telemetry: expected ~400k inference-requests / month, mostly short chat reqs. If we map to API units that's ~120M tokens => charges vary a lot. Recommend we define tiers as:
```
- Seat (named users) - for UI seats only
- API compute units - measured in 100M tokens equivalence or vCPU-hrs
```

Samir Patel: Legal prefer a simple mapping. Suggest redline for Section 3.2: "'Utilization Unit' means an API Compute Unit equal to 100,000,000 generated tokens or the equivalent vCPU-hour conversion as agreed in writing." Also clarify SLA credit: cap monthly credits to 100% of that month's charges and define measurement window.

Maria Chen: that language looks good. Procurement will also ask for a carveout: POC overage cap / free buffer for first 90 days. Can we add a line for 'Initial POC Buffer: first 90 days free up to X units'?

Samir Patel: add: "Initial POC Buffer: Customer will not be billed for overage up to 50% above Usage Commit for first 90 days of the POC." keeps it bounded.

Jessie Rivera: who signs? This is >$75k ARR if converted. We need exec counterparty sign. Contracts-bot: e-sign envelope created for AcmeHealth (env_789) :eyes:

contracts-bot: Envelope env_789 created and routed to AcmeHealth-legal. Status: awaiting signer.

Maria Chen: awesome. Action items: Samir to produce redline; Jessie to update order form with POC Buffer and routing; Pranav to provide token/vCPU estimates by EOD. I'll coordinate with AcmeHealth CS for signature lane. Thanks :raised_hands:

Pranav Rao: sending estimates now (link to sheet) - expect moderate burst during demo week.

Samir Patel: I'll post the redline in #legal-drafts in ~2 hours.

Jessie Rivera: noted. I'll queue for exec approval after redline. :thumbsup:
